== Summary ==
The Star Wars CCG Players Committee organization chart (one page, "Star Wars CCG Players Committee &ndash; Organization Chart"), rendered at 170 dpi from the PDF created on 8 July 2021 (PDF author metadata: Jared Napolitano), as captured by the Wayback Machine on 5 October 2021.

== Source ==
* Original PDF address: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf] (the current chart is published at the same address)
* Archived copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback Machine, captured 5 October 2021]

Used on [[Players Committee organization]].
